finish_summary:
bulk_discount_percent(50) incorrectly returns 0 instead of 10.
parse_coupon is case‑sensitive and rejects lower/mixed‑case coupons; the specification requires it to be case‑insensitive.
Cart.remove_item leaves an item with quantity 0 rather than removing it entirely when the remaining quantity reaches zero or less.
Cart.total calculates shipping_fee using the original subtotal after coupon instead of using the discounted amount; thus shipping is applied incorrectly.
